answerToDispatchItem1_countByBasisAndWri.writerFinding: EVERY county's basis sentence carries an `authority` naming the writer and a `scopeSearched` naming the exact scope, and in five of the six basis classes that writer is `cad_property` at a declared tax_year. But `recordRetirement` carries NO run id of its own — its keys are exactly asOf, basis, status, verdict, authority, scopeSearched, lastSeenTaxYear. So 'which run retired this' is unanswerable from the served payload, and only the snapshot's publishRunId is available. This is the served-side repeat of the gap P-275 found on the atom path (_inbox/2026-09-17_p275-live-currency-five-counties_close.json). Named as a fix candidate, not fixed by this lane.

countingRules: SUCCESSOR: the retired row's normalized situs decomposes to a NON-EMPTY street, and at least one NON-RETIRED node in the SAME county carries the identical normalized (street|city|state|zip). Normalization: split the raw situs on commas first, uppercase, strip every non-alphanumeric run to a single space, collapse whitespace, trim.

UNMEASURED (situs axis): the street component is empty (e.g. ', TX', ', TX 78731') or the situs value is a JSON document rather than an address. Such a row can be joined to nothing and is NEVER counted as 'no successor'.

ABSENT_AT_SOURCE: the P-275 registry's tri-state reader was asked about this exact id and did not return it. An id the reader could not be asked about is UNMEASURED, never absent (proven with the TLS flag, falsifier F4).

NAMESPACE CONTROL: the same reader, asked about 400 of the county's own LIVE node ids, must answer live at >= 0.95 before that county's retired-side absences are called evidence. Measured: Hays 0.9975 (passes), Travis 0.7725, Caldwell 0.5725, Williamson 0.0000. Where the control fails, the absence counts are REPORTED with the control beside them and are NOT called confirmed.

sums.check: the cross-tab counts sum to each county's retired total exactly; no bucket is derived by subtraction.

Every other read ran under a lease keyed on the store's HOST, taken and released per county; no lease was ever held across counties and none was held across the lane.

The first pass's reading is superseded, not averaged, and both passes are on disk.

SIZE: two statements carried IN-lists of 282,570 and 58,015 literals as psql -f files of 11.3 MB and 1.9 MB. Both are primary-key array lookups and both ran under a lease; recorded because that is far larger than 'a keyed lookup'.

A METHOD BUG THAT WOULD HAVE PRODUCED A WRONG ANSWER, found and fixed: the first successor instrument normalized each situs BEFORE splitting it on commas, which erased the delimiters and read ', TX' as the street 'TX'. It classified Travis's 7,249 address-less rows as address-bearing. Fixed by splitting the raw string first; the corrected instrument is the only one whose numbers appear here.

namedFixesForLaterRows: P-309-F1 (highest value): 846 of Hays's 1,386 CAD-roll-absence retirements are contradicted by the store's own roll. The payload's own scopeSearched says 'cad_property, ALL rows (not filtered to a use code), county_fips 48209 tax_year 2026', and 846 of those ids carry a tax_year-2026 row ingested 2026-09-14, three days before the retirement was written. Either the bake's reader is filtering the roll by a vintage it does not declare, or it is reading the wrong drop. This is a claim about the BAKE, not about the customer's map, and it is 61.0% of one basis class.

P-309-F2: the served retirement payload records WHEN but never BY WHICH RUN. `recordRetirement` has no run id; only the snapshot's publishRunId exists. Same gap P-275 found on the atom path, now confirmed on the served path.

P-309-F3: 20 served rows carry a JSON DOCUMENT in the situs field (15 Hays, 5 Williamson), including node:48491:PRIVATE ROAD. A served address that is a claim object cannot be joined, geocoded or rendered.
P-309-F4: node:48491:PRIVATE ROAD is a served retired node whose 'prop_id' is the literal string 'PRIVATE ROAD'. A non-identity entered the roll-absence path and is served as a declined parcel.

P-309-F5: the P-275 registry's Williamson entry cannot speak about the store's live Williamson population at all (control live-share 0.0000), and its Caldwell entry speaks at 0.5725. Any later row that reads a P-275 reader's output as evidence should read control-live-<fips>.json first; the registry has no such self-check built in.
whatThisLaneDidNotDo: Wrote nothing: no store write, no retire, no reactivate, no publish, no deploy. Every database session carried default_transaction_read_only=on.
Did not call a namespace-mismatched absence a contradiction, and did not call a geometry-presence reading a roll-membership reading.
Did not claim a successor from a label match: every successor in this lane is a normalized situs equality with its fan-out reported.
Did not read txgio_parcel as a live-currency source.
Did not fix anything it found. Every fix is named above for a later row.
